provenance: Project-authored inert adversarial fixtures. Adapted containment and boundary-test patterns from the seven pinned candidates in evidence/P9.2-reuse.json; no upstream test pass claimed.
versionRationale: Initial explicit security expectations from approved security/access contracts. Digests bind authored inert content, not runtime snapshots. Unknown token counts fail closed under the default token ceiling, preserving the existing explicitly configured token-budget contract.

expectedOutcomes.LOOPBACK-PRIVATE-LINKLOCAL-METADATA: All forbidden IPv4/IPv6 and mixed DNS answers denied before connect; public IPv6 succeeds.
expectedOutcomes.DNS-REBINDING: A new DNS answer on redirect and a changed actual peer are denied before request bytes.
expectedOutcomes.FORBIDDEN-REDIRECT: Every redirect is fully revalidated, maximum three; fourth redirect denied.
expectedOutcomes.FILE-SCHEME: Non-HTTPS, non-443, credentials, fragment and non-allowlisted hosts denied before DNS.
expectedOutcomes.NO-CREDENTIAL-FORWARDING: No caller headers API; cookies discarded; peer rejected before HTTP write.
expectedOutcomes.SYMLINK-TRAVERSAL: Traversal, encoded separators, symlinks and hardlinks rejected before read.
expectedOutcomes.ARCHIVE-BOMB: Small ZIP expanding to 2 MiB rejected before extraction or parser launch.
expectedOutcomes.MALICIOUS-PDF: Active PDF cannot launch without sandbox; no staging or executable side effect.
expectedOutcomes.TOKEN-FLOOD: Known token flood and unknown token count denied before provider dispatch.
expectedOutcomes.PROMPT-INJECTION: Exact text remains untrusted with memory activation false; self-promotion refused.
expectedOutcomes.BOUNDED-RESOURCES: Upload, JSON, UTF-8 query, pages, assets, CPU, memory, time and output ceilings enforced.
expectedOutcomes.TENANT-QUOTAS: Cross-process worker and HTTP concurrency/rate overflow has no application effect; independent tenant succeeds.
expectedOutcomes.R35-A01: Durable exact replay accepted, changed payload or expected epoch conflicting; stale mutation has no success receipt.
expectedOutcomes.R35-A02: Private redirect, traversal paths and raw SQL-like filter rejected before privileged operation.
expectedOutcomes.DT-I16: Archive/OOXML unsupported by default. No enabled archive parser or unbounded decompression path added.
expectedOutcomes.FIXTURE-INTEGRITY: Version, provenance, license, expected outcomes, digests and executable IDs present.
expectedOutcomes.RUNNER-NEGATIVES: Unknown group, missing case, skipped/failed child and zero tests fail closed.
